nodes.rationale: verify_jwt disabled at gateway because JWT belongs to PMO backend; function validates it against /home/datosusuario before using service key.

nodes.label: pmo-management-edit function
nodes.rationale: Validates report ownership; technical credentials stay inside Supabase.

nodes.label: pmo-send-logs function
nodes.rationale: Scopes consultants to own logs; global scope only for admin emails; stores no tokens/passwords.

nodes.label: application layer
nodes.rationale: Use cases and ports; depends only on domain.

nodes.label: npm run check:architecture
nodes.rationale: Automated checks: four root layers, allowed dependency direction, no Angular in domain/application, no direct HTTP in presentation, no explicit any, endpoints centralized in environments, no legacy src/app code.

nodes.label: domain layer
nodes.rationale: Models, rules and business contracts; no Angular or external deps.

nodes.label: infrastructure layer
nodes.rationale: HTTP, Supabase, geolocation and persistence adapters implementing application/domain contracts.

nodes.label: npm run verify
nodes.rationale: Runs architecture rules plus production build; strict and strictTemplates must stay enabled.

nodes.label: presentation layer
nodes.rationale: Shell, pages, components, pipes; consumes use cases/facades, never calls HTTP/Supabase/geolocation directly.

nodes.label: Legacy DDD feature-sliced structure (src/app/features)
nodes.rationale: Older layout grouping layers inside features/time-records; superseded by layer-first structure in ARCHITECTURE.md.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture (layer-first)
nodes.rationale: Organized by layer first, then by business capability, so dependency direction stays explicit.

nodes.label: Composition root (app.config.ts + shell/providers)
nodes.rationale: Only place where contracts are wired to concrete adapters.

nodes.label: Regla de dependencias
nodes.rationale: presentation->application->domain; infrastructure->application/domain. Swapping PMO API, Supabase or geolocation should only require replacing adapters and composition root config.

nodes.label: Criterio de migración
nodes.rationale: Changing backend/Supabase/geolocation source must not touch models, domain rules, use cases or components.

nodes.label: Publishable key only in Angular
nodes.rationale: Never copy service_role to frontend; technical secrets live in Supabase secrets, not src/environments.

nodes.label: Formato de texto aceptado (fecha / rango hora descripción | cliente | ricef | proyecto | solicitud)

nodes.label: RLS read-only policies
nodes.rationale: App only reads; writes go via service_role SQL function behind Edge Functions.
